files.Title: GameEventScript.Api.GameEventScriptHost
files.Summary: Serial message host for native handlers and optional GameEventScript programs. The portable core performs no synchronization and creates no worker threads.

files.Title: GameEventScript.Api.GameEventScriptMessage
files.Summary: Represents a message used within the Game Event Script system. This message serves as a fundamental unit for communication, allowing for event-driven execution between components, scripts, and handlers.

files.Title: GameEventScript.Api.GameEventScriptProgram
files.Summary: The immutable, reusable parsed representation of one .gesb V1 program, produced only by the Compiler or by , both of which run the complete program validator before returning it.

files.Title: GameEventScript.Api.GesBinaryBindKind
files.Summary: Identifies the role of a entry: an executable declaration, an outbound message signature or a host import.

files.Title: GameEventScript.Api.GesBinaryFormat
files.Summary: Fixed constants of the canonical little-endian .gesb V1 container framing.

files.Title: GameEventScript.Api.GesBindingSegment.Entry
files.Summary: One immutable binding record. In .gesb the argument-name and tag lists are UInt16IndexListSegment indices; this model holds their resolved elements, which are string-constant indices.

files.Title: GameEventScript.Api.GesBindingSegment
files.Summary: The immutable BindingSegment (section 0x0004): the program's exported handlers and callables, imported extensions and external types, outbound message signatures and Record constructors, in encoded order.

files.Title: GameEventScript.Api.GesBitReader
files.Summary: Reads values of 0 to 64 bits from untrusted data in the bit order of the schema wire format: least significant bit first, bytes in Little Endian order. It knows no schema; generated schema code and build on it. Reading allocates nothing.

files.Title: GameEventScript.Api.GesBitWriter
files.Summary: Writes values of 0 to 64 bits into a caller's buffer in the bit order of the schema wire format: least significant bit first, bytes in Little Endian order. It knows no schema; generated schema code and build on it. Writing allocates nothing.

files.Title: GameEventScript.Api.GesBoundNetwork
files.Summary: A network bound to parameter values. Immutable; it can be shared between threads and connections.

files.Title: GameEventScript.Api.GesBoundSchema
files.Summary: A schema, message or message set bound to parameter values. Immutable; it can be shared between threads.

files.Title: GameEventScript.Api.GesBox
files.Summary: An axis-aligned box between two corners, without a unit. Creating one orders its corners, so is never above on an axis; a 2D box has Z 0 on both. Scripts see it as the external type :Box of .

files.Title: GameEventScript.Api.GesBuildMetadataSegment
files.Summary: The immutable optional BuildMetadataSegment (section 0x0030), which names the producing compiler. Runtime behaviour never depends on it.

files.Title: GameEventScript.Api.GesBytecodeInstruction
files.Summary: One logical bytecode instruction: an opcode, a unit-and-flags byte, three 16-bit operand words and a 64-bit payload, encoded as 16 bytes in .gesb. The named properties are opcode-specific views of the same words; the in-memory layout does not define the encoding.

files.Title: GameEventScript.Api.GesBytecodeOpCode
files.Summary: Identifies a V1 bytecode instruction. The numeric values are part of the .gesb format; operand layouts and semantics are defined in the bytecode specification.

files.Title: GameEventScript.Api.GesBytecodePatternKind
files.Summary: Identifies the dice pattern of and .

files.Title: GameEventScript.Api.GesBytecodeSeriesKind
files.Summary: Identifies a built-in lazy numeric series for .

files.Title: GameEventScript.Api.GesBytecodeTypeKind
files.Summary: Identifies portable value kinds and VM-internal storage kinds used as bytecode type operands.

files.Title: GameEventScript.Api.GesCodeSegment
files.Summary: The immutable CodeSegment (section 0x0010): the program's single linear instruction table of at most 65,535 instructions, each encoded as 16 bytes. A code address is the zero-based index of an instruction in this table.

files.Title: GameEventScript.Api.GesCompileException
files.Summary: Represents an exception that occurs during the compilation process of a Game Event Script. This exception is specifically used to signal issues detected during the parsing or validation phase of script compilation.

files.Title: GameEventScript.Api.GesCompileOptions
files.Summary: Represents a game event script compile options.

files.Title: GameEventScript.Api.GesContext
files.Summary: Host-owned context shared by native and GameEventScript handlers.

files.Title: GameEventScript.Api.GesDebugInfoOptions
files.Summary: Selects which optional debug sections the Compiler emits. Compilation includes all of them by default; size-sensitive builds opt out with .

files.Title: GameEventScript.Api.GesDebugSymbol
files.Summary: Names one physical register over a half-open range of code addresses. Only explicit script parameters and locals are named; compiler temporaries are not.

files.Title: GameEventScript.Api.GesDebugSymbolKind
files.Summary: The kind of a named register in ; the numeric values are the encoded SymbolKind byte.

files.Title: GameEventScript.Api.GesDebugSymbolsSegment
files.Summary: The immutable optional DebugSymbolsSegment (section 0x0020), which names script parameters and locals by register and code range. Runtime behaviour never depends on it.

files.Title: GameEventScript.Api.GesDeclaredExternalTypeCatalog
files.Summary: Immutable external type catalog built from a fixed list of definitions.

files.Title: GameEventScript.Api.GesDiagnostic
files.Summary: A portable diagnostic of a source, binary, linking or runtime failure. and identify it; the optional fields add structured context and are absent when unknown.

files.Title: GameEventScript.Api.GesDiagnosticCodes
files.Summary: Defines the stable diagnostic code strings; a code is compared together with its , never through the message text.

files.Title: GameEventScript.Api.GesDiagnosticPhase
files.Summary: Identifies the pipeline stage in which a diagnostic originated; the numeric values are stable.

files.Title: GameEventScript.Api.GesDiagnosticSymbolKind
files.Summary: Identifies the role of the optional symbol named by a diagnostic.

files.Title: GameEventScript.Api.GesDisc
files.Summary: A filled circle in the plane z = 0, without a unit: a centre and a radius. Creating one takes the radius's magnitude. A disc is valid with a finite centre in the plane and a finite radius; the operations of an invalid one give null, as GES operations give nothing for a domain failure. Scripts see it as the external type :Disc of .

files.Title: GameEventScript.Api.GesDocument
files.Summary: An immutable GES document: a Map or Record root with an optional schema reference, read from and printed to human-editable .gesd text. Comments and layout are not part of a document.

files.Title: GameEventScript.Api.GesDocumentException
files.Summary: GES document text is invalid or exceeds a fixed literal parsing limit.

files.Title: GameEventScript.Api.GesDocumentFormat
files.Summary: Layout options for printing GES documents and values. Layout is a recommendation: every printed document reads back to an equal document, while indentation, line breaks and numeric spelling may differ between implementations.

files.Title: GameEventScript.Api.GesDocumentSchema
files.Summary: The schema reference of a GES document. It is a reference only: GES neither loads schema files nor validates documents against record definitions.

files.Title: GameEventScript.Api.GesDocumentSchemaKind
files.Summary: The kind of schema a GES document references.

files.Title: GameEventScript.Api.GesDynamicLinkException
files.Summary: Thrown when a Program cannot be linked to a host, for example because of a missing extension or external type constructor or an exceeded register or call-depth limit. It carries one or more link-phase diagnostics.

files.Title: GameEventScript.Api.GesExecutionResult
files.Summary: Provides an allocation-free summary of one host pump.

files.Title: GameEventScript.Api.GesExecutionState
files.Summary: Identifies why a synchronous host pump returned.

files.Title: GameEventScript.Api.GesExtensionCall
files.Summary: Reusable call-scoped adapter passed to : it lends the arguments, the host context and its random generator, and receives one result. The last setter call before the callback returns decides the result; without one the result is Nothing. The call must not be retained.

files.Title: GameEventScript.Api.GesExtensionFaultException
files.Summary: A deliberate, portable runtime fault that an extension function, native handler, external-type constructor, or implementation throws to report a defined failure. It ends the current handler with a diagnosable runtime error instead of silently evaluating to nothing; the host remains reusable for subsequently enqueued messages, as for any other runtime error.

files.Title: GameEventScript.Api.GesExtensionReference
files.Summary: Represents an immutable normalized extension name, function name, and ordered argument signature.

files.Title: GameEventScript.Api.GesExternalTypeConstructorCall
files.Summary: Reusable call-scoped adapter passed to : it lends the arguments and receives the constructed value. It must not be retained beyond the callback.

files.Title: GameEventScript.Api.GesExternalTypeConstructorDefinition
files.Summary: Immutable declarative signature of one external type constructor: the type it builds and its parameters.

files.Title: GameEventScript.Api.GesExternalTypeConstructorReference
files.Summary: Represents an immutable normalized external type name and constructor argument signature.

files.Title: GameEventScript.Api.GesExternalTypeDefinition
files.Summary: Immutable declarative description of one external type: its name, ordered unique fields and ordered unique constructor signatures.

files.Title: GameEventScript.Api.GesExternalTypeFieldDefinition
files.Summary: Immutable description of one external type field: its name and declared type. Field values are converted to the declared builtin type before a script sees them; Nothing stays Nothing.

files.Title: GameEventScript.Api.GesExternalTypeParameterDefinition
files.Summary: Immutable description of one external constructor parameter: its argument label, which must name a declared field, and its declared type. Arguments are converted to the declared builtin type before the constructor sees them; Nothing stays Nothing.

files.Title: GameEventScript.Api.GesFatalRuntimeException
files.Summary: Base class of exceptions that carry a runtime and end the current handler with that diagnostic. The exception message is the diagnostic's message.

files.Title: GameEventScript.Api.GesFloatRange
files.Summary: An immutable binary64 range descriptor; terms are computed lazily.

files.Title: GameEventScript.Api.GesGeometryLibrary
files.Summary: The standard geometry library: the external types :Box, :Poly and :Disc over , and , and the extension functions :geometry.*, so that hosts and scripts compute alike. A host that wants it passes to the compiler and and to the host, each in front of its own catalog or registry, which resolves what the library does not.

files.Title: GameEventScript.Api.GesHostBuilder
files.Summary: Configures and creates independent serial instances.

files.Title: GameEventScript.Api.GesIntegerRange
files.Summary: An immutable signed-64 range descriptor. Terms are computed lazily without binary64 conversion.

files.Title: GameEventScript.Api.GesLiteralLimitException
files.Summary: Literal recognition outside a Host exceeded one of its fixed protection limits.

files.Title: GameEventScript.Api.GesMessageArgument
files.Summary: One named value in an ordered message argument list.

files.Title: GameEventScript.Api.GesMessageArguments
files.Summary: Ordered message arguments. Argument names are part of the message signature and therefore preserve source order.

files.Title: GameEventScript.Api.GesMessageFormatException
files.Summary: Invalid, unsupported, or over-limit portable message/value JSON.

files.Title: GameEventScript.Api.GesMessageSignature
files.Summary: Represents a message signature used in GameEventScript to uniquely define the structure of a message, including its name and ordered parameter list. This class provides utilities to normalize, validate, and match message signatures accurately.

files.Title: GameEventScript.Api.GesNetwork
files.Summary: A network declaration: the routes of one client–server pair. Immutable; it can be bound any number of times.

files.Title: GameEventScript.Api.GesNetworkClass
files.Summary: The delivery class of a network route.

files.Title: GameEventScript.Api.GesNetworkRoute
files.Summary: One route of a network. Immutable.

files.Title: GameEventScript.Api.GesNetworkSide
files.Summary: The side a network route starts from.

files.Title: GameEventScript.Api.GesNetworkVerb
files.Summary: How a network route carries its root.

files.Title: GameEventScript.Api.GesOpaqueSection
files.Summary: An optional section the reader retained without interpreting it under : an unknown optional section, or a known optional section with an unsupported version or compression. The writer re-emits it unchanged after the known sections.

files.Title: GameEventScript.Api.GesPoint
files.Summary: A position with three Binary64 components and no unit, the native counterpart of a GES Point. A 2D point has 0. As in the language, a point moves by a , two points give a vector, and a point does not scale. The unit belongs to the schema or host and is applied when it converts to or from a .

files.Title: GameEventScript.Api.GesPoly
files.Summary: A closed polygon in the plane z = 0, without a unit: its points in order, the last connecting to the first. A polygon is valid with at least three finite points in the plane, no edge of zero length, no two edges that cross or overlap, and an area other than zero; the operations of an invalid one give null, as GES operations give nothing for a domain failure. Scripts see it as the external type :Poly of .

files.Title: GameEventScript.Api.GesProfilePhase
files.Summary: Non-overlapping regions of an instrumented VM loop; timing policies belong to the embedding.

files.Title: GameEventScript.Api.GesProgramBuilder
files.Summary: Compiles source text into immutable Programs using the optional GameEventScript.Compiler package.

files.Title: GameEventScript.Api.GesProgramBuilderEntry
files.Summary: Adds the Program builder entry point to when the Compiler package is referenced.

files.Title: GameEventScript.Api.GesProgramFormatErrorCode
files.Summary: The stable portable error codes of . The numeric values are fixed by the binary format specification; the diagnostic code is decode. followed by the camel-case name.

files.Title: GameEventScript.Api.GesProgramFormatException
files.Summary: Thrown when a .gesb image or a program is malformed, unsupported, exceeds read limits, or violates a program invariant. Raised by reading, writing, size calculation, validation and Host.Load.

files.Title: GameEventScript.Api.GesProgramInstance
files.Summary: Represents one host-local loading of a reusable immutable program.

files.Title: GameEventScript.Api.GesProgramMetadataSegment
files.Summary: The immutable decoded ProgramMetadataSegment (section 0x0001) of a .gesb V1 program: module identity, program-level resource bounds and the application-owned program version.

files.Title: GameEventScript.Api.GesProgramReadLimits
files.Summary: Resource bounds that checks before allocating. Exceeding a count limit fails with , a byte limit with the code named on the property; a limit outside its supported range makes Read throw .

files.Title: GameEventScript.Api.GesProgramReadOptions
files.Summary: Options for .

files.Title: GameEventScript.Api.GesProgramRetention
files.Summary: Selects which optional sections keeps. The five required runtime sections are always read, and an unknown section flagged as required always fails.

files.Title: GameEventScript.Api.GesPublishResult
files.Summary: Describes the independent local and outbound outcomes of one publish operation without allocating.

files.Title: GameEventScript.Api.GesQuantityUnit
files.Summary: Defines the supported game event script bytecode instruction unit values.

files.Title: GameEventScript.Api.GesQuantityUnits
files.Summary: Names, spellings and arithmetic of the closed set of GameEventScript quantity units.

files.Title: GameEventScript.Api.GesRandomGenerator
files.Summary: A sealed class that provides mechanisms for generating random numbers or values, either through a pseudo-random number generator or a predefined sequence of values. This class is useful for scenarios where deterministic or non-deterministic random value generation is required, especially in game event scripts.

files.Title: GameEventScript.Api.GesReadOnlyArray<T>
files.Summary: Immutable array view used by portable programs and other immutable API models.

files.Title: GameEventScript.Api.GesRuntimeLimits
files.Summary: The safety limits of one host: work, nesting and collection sizes per handler and the queue of the host. They bound time and stack use, not memory (specs/HostRuntime.md). Exceeding most limits stops the active handler with a structured runtime-limit observation; the remarks of each property state its exact outcome.

files.Title: GameEventScript.Api.GesSchema
files.Summary: The immutable description of one schema, message or message set of a . It can be shared between threads and bound any number of times.

files.Title: GameEventScript.Api.GesSchemaAxisInfo
files.Summary: The limits of a numeric axis of a Point, Vector, Box, Poly or Disc, or of the radius of a Disc.

files.Title: GameEventScript.Api.GesSchemaBound
files.Summary: A bound, step or delta range: a parameter or an exact decimal.

files.Title: GameEventScript.Api.GesSchemaComputedFieldInfo
files.Summary: A field written computed by: a value derived from the other fields that is never encoded or read from a document.

files.Title: GameEventScript.Api.GesSchemaConstantInfo
files.Summary: A constant of a schema, declared as let name be value: never encoded, part of the hash, and generated as a static member of the schema's types.

files.Title: GameEventScript.Api.GesSchemaDecoded
files.Summary: A decoded top-level value and the bytes it occupied.

files.Title: GameEventScript.Api.GesSchemaDefaultEntryInfo
files.Summary: A field that a record literal default names, with its value.

files.Title: GameEventScript.Api.GesSchemaDefaultInfo
files.Summary: The value a field takes when a value or document leaves it out, declared with default; the wire always carries the field.

files.Title: GameEventScript.Api.GesSchemaDefaultKind
files.Summary: The kinds of a field's default.

files.Title: GameEventScript.Api.GesSchemaDelta
files.Summary: Converts between full records of a schema and deltas against a baseline, the full record the receiver already holds. Both directions compare wire values and allocate nothing on success. Data is untrusted: every limit is checked, and invalid data fails with a .

files.Title: GameEventScript.Api.GesSchemaDeltaDecoded
files.Summary: The sizes of a decoded delta.

files.Title: GameEventScript.Api.GesSchemaDocument
files.Summary: A GES document read against the schema its header names, as generated models read their documents: the header :Schema(:Name) names one of the expected schemas, the document passes the schema's check, and its entries are the plain value that a model converts. Errors carry their position and field path.

files.Title: GameEventScript.Api.GesSchemaDump
files.Summary: Makes binary data readable through a bound schema.

files.Title: GameEventScript.Api.GesSchemaDumpResult
files.Summary: The readable form of encoded data.

files.Title: GameEventScript.Api.GesSchemaException
files.Summary: A schema source or a binding that breaks a rule. Callers branch on , a stable schema.* code; the message is informative text.

files.Title: GameEventScript.Api.GesSchemaField
files.Summary: The handle of a field in a bound schema. Resolving it once makes further uses free of lookups.

files.Title: GameEventScript.Api.GesSchemaFieldInfo
files.Summary: A field of a schema or an argument of a message.

files.Title: GameEventScript.Api.GesSchemaKind
files.Summary: The kinds of declarations that have a hash and can be bound.

files.Title: GameEventScript.Api.GesSchemaParameterInfo
files.Summary: A parameter that a declaration reaches and every binding must supply.

files.Title: GameEventScript.Api.GesSchemaParameters
files.Summary: The parameter values of one binding.

files.Title: GameEventScript.Api.GesSchemaReader
files.Summary: Decodes one top-level record or message without allocating on success. Data is untrusted: every limit is checked, and invalid data fails with a . Fields are read in declaration order.

files.Title: GameEventScript.Api.GesSchemaSet
files.Summary: Validated schema sources. A set is immutable and can be bound any number of times, also with different parameter values within one session.

files.Title: GameEventScript.Api.GesSchemaSource
files.Summary: A named schema source text.

files.Title: GameEventScript.Api.GesSchemaTakeInfo
files.Summary: The fields a schema takes from another with with.

files.Title: GameEventScript.Api.GesSchemaType
files.Summary: The type of a field, or one alternative of a union.

files.Title: GameEventScript.Api.GesSchemaTypeKind
files.Summary: The kinds of types a schema field can have.

files.Title: GameEventScript.Api.GesSchemaValues
files.Summary: The convenient path between GES values and the wire, for rare data. A Record or Map encodes by field name, and fields without a schema entry, such as computed fields, are not transmitted. Only a Map that selects a union alternative must have a field for each of its keys. Time-critical code uses and .

files.Title: GameEventScript.Api.GesSchemaWriter
files.Summary: Encodes one top-level record or message into a caller's buffer without allocating on success. Fields are written in declaration order; a nested schema, Point or Vector is entered with .

files.Title: GameEventScript.Api.GesSectionFlags
files.Summary: The SectionFlags word of a section header. Bits outside and are invalid in V1.

files.Title: GameEventScript.Api.GesSectionType
files.Summary: The assigned .gesb section type IDs, listed in canonical writer order. Types 0x0000 and 0xFFFF are invalid; 0x8000–0xFFFD are free for private or experimental optional sections.

files.Title: GameEventScript.Api.GesSourceArchiveEntry
files.Summary: One embedded compiler input in the : the exact logical source as UTF-8, without the original byte order mark or file encoding.

files.Title: GameEventScript.Api.GesSourceArchiveSegment
files.Summary: The immutable optional SourceArchiveSegment (section 0x0022), which embeds the compiler inputs.

files.Title: GameEventScript.Api.GesSourceLocation
files.Summary: Represents a specific location in a source file or module for the GameEventScript compiler. This class is used to pinpoint the origin of a particular piece of code or error within a source context.

files.Title: GameEventScript.Api.GesSourceMapEntry
files.Summary: Maps a half-open range of code addresses to a range of UTF-8 bytes in one source.

files.Title: GameEventScript.Api.GesSourceMapSegment
files.Summary: The immutable optional SourceMapSegment (section 0x0021), which maps code addresses to source byte ranges. It is useful without an embedded ; when both are present they must agree.

files.Title: GameEventScript.Api.GesSourceMapSource
files.Summary: Describes one compiler input in the . All offsets and lengths count bytes of the logical UTF-8 source, not UTF-16 code units.

files.Title: GameEventScript.Api.GesStartResult
files.Summary: Describes completed initialization independently of queue idleness.

files.Title: GameEventScript.Api.GesStartState
files.Summary: Identifies the outcome of host or instance initialization.

files.Title: GameEventScript.Api.GesStringConstantSegment.SliceEntry
files.Summary: Locates one string entry inside .

files.Title: GameEventScript.Api.GesStringConstantSegment
files.Summary: The immutable StringConstantSegment (section 0x0002): an ordered pool of at most 65,535 strict UTF-8 strings that bytecode and bindings reference by zero-based index. Order and duplicates are program data.

files.Title: GameEventScript.Api.GesSubscription
files.Summary: Represents one host-local native message subscription.

files.Title: GameEventScript.Api.GesSystemClock
files.Summary: The system monotonic clock, measured from the moment the instance was created. Reading allocates nothing and is unaffected by changes of the wall-clock time. An instance may be shared between hosts and network ends that use one timeline.

files.Title: GameEventScript.Api.GesUInt16IndexList
files.Summary: A read-only view of one list of a , such as an argument register list or a message shape; it shares the segment's storage without copying.

files.Title: GameEventScript.Api.GesUInt16IndexListSegment.SliceEntry
files.Summary: Locates one list inside .

files.Title: GameEventScript.Api.GesUInt16IndexListSegment
files.Summary: The immutable UInt16IndexListSegment (section 0x0003): at most 65,535 ordered lists of elements that bindings and instructions reference by zero-based list index. The referencing field or opcode defines what the elements mean, for example string indices of argument names and tags, or register lists.

files.Title: GameEventScript.Api.GesVector
files.Summary: A displacement with three Binary64 components and no unit, the native counterpart of a GES Vector. A 2D vector has 0. The unit belongs to the schema or host that uses the value and is applied when it converts to or from a .

files.Title: GameEventScript.Api.GesVirtualClock
files.Summary: A virtual clock for deterministic simulation and tests: its time changes only through . Not thread-safe; one caller at a time, like the host or end that reads it.

files.Title: GameEventScript.Api.GesWireException
files.Summary: A value that cannot be encoded, or data that is not a valid encoding. The error names the field path and holds no value from the data, so it can be logged safely.

files.Title: GameEventScript.Api.GesWireRules
files.Summary: The value rules of the schema wire format over plain operands: Text and tag validity, the exact quantization of a step p / 10^k and wrapping. Generated schema code calls them with constant operands, and the interpreted writer and reader use the same rules, so both encode identical bytes.

files.Title: GameEventScript.Api.IGesClock
files.Summary: Supplies monotonic elapsed time to a serial host or a network end. Implementations must never move backwards.

files.Title: GameEventScript.Api.IGesExtensionFunction
files.Summary: Synchronous host callback that implements one extension function.

files.Title: GameEventScript.Api.IGesExtensionRegistry
files.Summary: Resolves the host's extension functions for the extension imports of a Program while Host.Load links it; it is not consulted per invocation.

files.Title: GameEventScript.Api.IGesExternalTypeCatalog
files.Summary: Declarative compile-time description of the external types a host offers: names, fields and constructor signatures, without constructors, field accessors or host instances.

files.Title: GameEventScript.Api.IGesExternalTypeConstructor
files.Summary: Host implementation of one declared external type constructor.

files.Title: GameEventScript.Api.IGesExternalTypeRegistry
files.Summary: Resolves the host's external type constructors for the constructor imports of a Program while Host.Load links it; it is not consulted per call.

files.Title: GameEventScript.Api.IGesExternalValue
files.Summary: A host object exposed to scripts as a value of a declared external type. The runtime keeps no field values: every script field read calls again, and every conversion to Map, JSON or schema encoding reads all declared fields in declaration order.

files.Title: GameEventScript.Api.IGesNativeMessageHandler
files.Summary: Portable synchronous message handler invoked by a .

files.Title: GameEventScript.Api.IGesProfiler
files.Summary: Optional synchronous instrumentation factory. Callbacks must not throw or reenter a host. Timing, allocation and report policies belong to the embedding. Instances require serialized access.

files.Title: GameEventScript.Api.IGesProgramProfiler
files.Summary: Instruction-boundary callbacks for one loaded instance. Callbacks must not throw, pump a host, or modify execution. No callback is made while the host waits between slices.

files.Title: GameEventScript.Api.IGesPublishSink
files.Summary: Receives synchronous outbound publications after the host has attempted local enqueue.

files.Title: GameEventScript.Api.IGesRuntimeObserver
files.Summary: Observes synchronous host behavior without participating in dispatch. Implementations must not throw and must not recursively pump the observed host. Every queued emit, processed publish, received message, delayed send and initialization message carries a host-local send ID: it starts at 1, increases by one per such send and is reported by every callback about that send, from emit, publish or scheduling to each dispatch or discard. 0 reports a send without an ID. Every callback has an empty default implementation, so an observer implements only the callbacks it needs.

files.Title: GameEventScript.CSharpBridge.GesBridgeContextExtensions
files.Summary: Provides C# tuple and dictionary conveniences for context messaging.

files.Title: GameEventScript.CSharpBridge.GesBridgeExtensionRegistry
files.Summary: Immutable extension registry built from -annotated types through Reflection.

files.Title: GameEventScript.CSharpBridge.GesBridgeExtensionRegistryBuilder
files.Summary: Collects attributed extension types and optionally falls back to a base registry for unknown signatures.

files.Title: GameEventScript.CSharpBridge.GesBridgeExternalTypeRegistry
files.Summary: Immutable external-type catalog and constructor registry built from -annotated CLR types.

files.Title: GameEventScript.CSharpBridge.GesBridgeHostExtensions
files.Summary: Provides delegate-based and automatic-runner conveniences that intentionally remain outside the portable Core.

files.Title: GameEventScript.CSharpBridge.GesBridgeHostRunner
files.Summary: Optional C# adapter that serializes host access and pumps accepted messages on a shared worker.

files.Title: GameEventScript.CSharpBridge.GesBridgeHostRunnerRegistration
files.Summary: A program instance or subscription owned by a . Every access goes through the runner's serialization gate, so another thread may use it while the runner pumps.

files.Title: GameEventScript.CSharpBridge.GesBridgeMessage
files.Summary: C#-specific message construction conveniences. Portable code uses ordered values directly.

files.Title: GameEventScript.CSharpBridge.GesBridgeMessageHandler
files.Summary: A delegate retained once at subscription time; dispatch invokes it synchronously.

files.Title: GameEventScript.CSharpBridge.GesBridgePublishSink
files.Summary: A synchronous outbound publish delegate; exceptions retain the Runtime's classification.

files.Title: GameEventScript.CSharpBridge.GesBridgeValueConversion
files.Summary: Provides C# dictionary factories for portable immutable values.

files.Title: GameEventScript.CSharpBridge.GesConstructAttribute
files.Summary: Represents a ges construct attribute.

files.Title: GameEventScript.CSharpBridge.GesExtensionAttribute
files.Summary: Represents a ges extension attribute.

files.Title: GameEventScript.CSharpBridge.GesFieldAttribute
files.Summary: Represents a ges field attribute.

files.Title: GameEventScript.CSharpBridge.GesFunctionAttribute
files.Summary: Exposes a method of a type as the extension function :extension.name(...).

files.Title: GameEventScript.CSharpBridge.GesParamAttribute
files.Summary: Represents a ges param attribute.

files.Title: GameEventScript.CSharpBridge.GesPredicateAttribute
files.Summary: Exposes a method with one parameter and a or nullable Boolean result as the predicate of value is :extension.name. It is registered with one unlabeled argument, whatever its parameter declares; null gives nothing.

files.Title: GameEventScript.CSharpBridge.GesTypeAttribute
files.Summary: Represents a ges type attribute.

files.Title: GameEventScript.Generator.GesGeneratedFile
files.Summary: A generated file: its name within the output directory and its text.

files.Title: GameEventScript.Generator.GesGeneratorException
files.Summary: A generation request that cannot be carried out, such as a name that two generated members share. Callers branch on , a stable generate.* code; the message is informative text.

files.Title: GameEventScript.Generator.GesSchemaAccess
files.Summary: The visibility of generated types.

files.Title: GameEventScript.Generator.GesSchemaGenerateOptions
files.Summary: How schema code is generated.

files.Title: GameEventScript.Generator.GesSchemaGenerator
files.Summary: Generates code and layouts from schemas at build time. Every type reached from the roots is bound once with the given parameters, so a type that several roots share appears once. The generator belongs to build tools and is never part of a game.

files.Title: GameEventScript.Generator.GesSchemaLanguage
files.Summary: A target language of generated schema code.

files.Title: GameEventScript.Generator.GesSchemaSplit
files.Summary: How generated code is divided into files.

files.Title: GameEventScript.Network.GesNetworkClientEnd
files.Summary: The client end of a session: it owns one client connection and its transport and drives both from . Sends, publishes and ticks made before the session is established wait in the end and reach the connection when it connects. One caller at a time; not thread-affine.

files.Title: GameEventScript.Network.GesNetworkClientSecurity
files.Summary: How a client protects its session: with the server's pinned public key, encrypted with a key the server sends during the handshake, or not at all. Immutable; safe to share between connections.

files.Title: GameEventScript.Network.GesNetworkCodes
files.Summary: The codes a connection closes or cancels a transfer with. Each is stable and language-neutral.

files.Title: GameEventScript.Network.GesNetworkConnection
files.Summary: One side of a network session: a synchronous state machine without threads, sockets or clocks. The host passes received bytes and the current time, takes events and takes packets to transmit. Times are microseconds of a monotonic clock chosen by the host. Not thread-safe; one caller at a time.

files.Title: GameEventScript.Network.GesNetworkCookieResult
files.Summary: What a server does with a datagram from an address it does not know.

files.Title: GameEventScript.Network.GesNetworkCookies
files.Summary: The address validation gate of a datagram server: it answers a client it does not know without keeping state, so a forged source address gains no connection. A cookie is the time window number and an HMAC-SHA256 of it and the address with a secret key; the current and the previous window are valid. Not thread-safe; one caller at a time.

files.Title: GameEventScript.Network.GesNetworkEndEvent
files.Summary: One end event. The payload is borrowed and valid until the handler returns.

files.Title: GameEventScript.Network.GesNetworkEndEventKind
files.Summary: The kind of an end event.

files.Title: GameEventScript.Network.GesNetworkEvent
files.Summary: One connection event. The payload is borrowed from the connection and valid until the next event is taken.

files.Title: GameEventScript.Network.GesNetworkEventKind
files.Summary: The kind of a connection event.

files.Title: GameEventScript.Network.GesNetworkKey
files.Summary: A server's static X25519 key pair, which encrypts its sessions. The client receives the public key from outside the protocol and pins it. Immutable; safe to share between connections.

files.Title: GameEventScript.Network.GesNetworkOptions
files.Summary: The limits and transport of one connection. Values are checked when a connection is created.

files.Title: GameEventScript.Network.GesNetworkPair
files.Summary: A client end and a server end connected within one process, without sockets. A realtime pair runs on the system clock and moves packets when the ends poll. A synchronous pair runs on a virtual clock, is connected when created and moves every packet before a send, publish, tick, close or poll returns: what one end sends is reported by the other end's next poll. In both modes a packet waits while the receiving connection takes no further bytes, in a synchronous pair until the host advances the clock far enough to refill its frame bucket; while 64 packets wait, the sending connection keeps its further packets. Both ends of a pair belong to one caller at a time.

files.Title: GameEventScript.Network.GesNetworkSecurity
files.Summary: The security level of a session.

files.Title: GameEventScript.Network.GesNetworkSendStatus
files.Summary: The result of sending a payload on a route.

files.Title: GameEventScript.Network.GesNetworkServerEnd
files.Summary: The server end of a session: it accepts clients from an acceptor, owns one server connection per client and drives all of them from . Clients have stable end-local ids. Publishes and ticks reach every client. One caller at a time; not thread-affine.

files.Title: GameEventScript.Network.GesNetworkServerSecurity
files.Summary: How a server protects its sessions: with its static key, or not at all. Immutable; safe to share between connections.

files.Title: GameEventScript.Network.GesNetworkSimulator
files.Summary: Connects a client and a server connection in one process with seeded latency. Each packet is delayed by the latency plus a draw from 0 to the jitter inclusive, but never arrives before a packet sent earlier in the same direction. Between datagram connections it may also lose, duplicate and reorder packets. Equal seeds, options and inputs give equal packets, events and times. The host takes the events of both connections between calls of . Not thread-safe.

files.Title: GameEventScript.Network.GesNetworkState
files.Summary: The state of a connection.

files.Title: GameEventScript.Network.GesNetworkTransport
files.Summary: How a transport carries packets.

files.Title: GameEventScript.Network.IGesNetworkAcceptor
files.Summary: Accepts the transports of a server end's clients.

files.Title: GameEventScript.Network.IGesNetworkConnector
files.Summary: Opens the transport of a client end.

files.Title: GameEventScript.Network.IGesNetworkEndHandler
files.Summary: Receives the events of an end during its poll.

files.Title: GameEventScript.Network.IGesNetworkLink
files.Summary: One connection's transport as an end drives it: it passes received packets to the connection and hands the connection's packets to the transport. Implementations come from a connector or an acceptor.

files.Title: GameEventScript.Network.Sockets.GesNetworkSocketConnector
files.Summary: Opens the TCP, WebSocket or UDP transport of a client end. Opening runs in the background: the end's first poll starts it, packets wait for it, and a failure to open ends the transport, so the connection closes with network.transportClosed. One connector serves one client end.

files.Title: GameEventScript.Network.Sockets.GesNetworkSocketListener
files.Summary: Accepts TCP, WebSocket or UDP clients for a server. A background task accepts sockets and, for WebSocket, answers the HTTP upgrade, or for UDP reads the shared socket, validates unknown addresses and routes each datagram to its client; the host takes each ready client with on its own thread. At most 64 clients wait or upgrade at once, accepting pauses while they do, and one IP address holds at most 8 of them; its further sockets are closed. As an it accepts the clients of a server end.

files.Title: GameEventScript.Network.Sockets.GesNetworkSocketSession
files.Summary: Carries one over a TCP stream, a WebSocket or UDP. Background tasks only move bytes: the host calls and , or for both, on its own thread, which feed received bytes into the connection, advance it and hand its packets to the sender. The connection is touched only by the host thread. As an it is the transport of an end.

files.Title: GameEventScript.Network.Sockets.GesNetworkSocketWaits
files.Summary: Waits for the work of an end whose transport is a socket: until one of its sockets received bytes, opened or ended, a client became ready, or the end's NextDeadline passes, whichever is first. The caller polls after each wait. A wait may end early; it never ends after the work arrived.

files.Title: GameEventScript.Runtime.Values.GesValue
files.Summary: An immutable GES value: Nothing, a number with optional quantity unit, Boolean, Text, Tag, Vector, Point, Dice, Bytes, List, Map, Record, external value, Range, Series, Message or Handler. Equality is strict and structural.

files.Title: GameEventScript.Runtime.Values.GesValueArguments
files.Summary: Ordered arguments of an extension call or external type constructor. A view lent by the virtual machine reads the caller's registers without copying and is valid only during that extension call: once the call has returned, every value access throws while stays unchanged. Copy any value needed later. A view created from an array borrows that array.

files.Title: GameEventScript.Runtime.Values.GesValueMap.Enumerator
files.Summary: Enumerates the entries of a in canonical key order.

files.Title: GameEventScript.Runtime.Values.GesValueMap
files.Summary: The immutable Text-keyed entries of a Map or the fields of a Record, with unique keys sorted by Unicode scalar values; indexing and enumeration follow that canonical order.

files.Title: GameEventScript.Runtime.Values.GesValueSlice
files.Summary: Read-only view of a contiguous run of values, for example the elements of a List returned by . The view borrows its storage without copying; indexers return read-only references into that storage.

files.Title: GameEventScript.Runtime
files.Summary: Public APIs for the Game Event Script libraries.

files.Title: GameEventScript.Syntax.GesAnsiRenderer
files.Summary: Optional pure string renderer. Terminal detection, NO_COLOR, console output and diagnostics belong to the embedding.

files.Title: GameEventScript.Syntax.GesHighlightDiagnostic
files.Summary: A diagnostic of the highlighted source: a syntax error or a violated single-source rule.

files.Title: GameEventScript.Syntax.GesHighlightResult
files.Summary: A highlighting result. An input above the length bound returns an incomplete result without spans or diagnostics.

files.Title: GameEventScript.Syntax.GesHighlightSpan
files.Summary: An immutable UTF-16 range with its category and the diagnostics that cover it.

files.Title: GameEventScript.Syntax.GesSyntaxHighlighter
files.Summary: Reusable GES, GESA and GES document highlighting, without a Compiler, Runtime, UI or terminal dependency.

files.Title: GameEventScript.Syntax.GesSyntaxKind
files.Summary: Theme-independent categories the highlighter derives from the syntax tree; these are not compiler tokens.

files.Title: GameEventScript.Syntax.GesSyntaxLanguage
files.Summary: The language a highlighter reads.

files.Title: GameEventScript
files.Summary: Public APIs for the Game Event Script libraries.
